entries.en: to repent; to feel remorse (variants: to repent and amend, to correct one's faults)

entries.zh: 悔悟（悔过自省、醒悟己非）
entries.en: to repent and awaken to one's faults; to reflect remorsefully on oneself

entries.zh: 悔過（悔认己过、痛改前非）
entries.en: to repent of one's faults; to acknowledge and repent one's offenses
to reform oneself; to repent of past faults and mend one's ways
to repent and be released from one's faults; to reform oneself
entries.notes: 音写两栏 cǎj/guài 均与“改”相合而字栏作“解”（闽南“解”亦读 kái），解/改两可，从悔改之义取释。

entries.en: to change; to amend oneself; to repent
to correct one's faults; to mend one's errors

entries.zh: 苦切（痛悔切肤、悲苦切心）
entries.en: to grieve bitterly; to feel sharp remorse and sorrow
entries.notes: 官话栏首音 cǐn 与“苦”不合（或为“悽/凄切”），据西义 pesalle（pesar，悲恸）与字、音栏主读取“苦切”痛悔之义。

entries.en: to go back on one's word; to regret and retract
entries.notes: 字栏作“及悔”，而闽南、官话两栏音写 huǎn/fǎn 均合“反”，疑字样有误，依音写与西义取“反悔”。

entries.en: to be ashamed and repent; to feel shame and remorse

entries.zh: 翻言旧语、重提前言（字样“話咀兩反”存疑）
entries.en: to speak again of something one said before; to go back over one's former words
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:話/詁]，且首音写 M 作 oá、R 作 hūn 互有出入，字样未能坐实，仅依西义 hablar de lo que antes dixo 释义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏[空]、官话栏[残]，西栏仅存“Arriba……navio……trimarse”残文，四栏不全，按残缺条处理。

entries.en: to lean on; to rely on
to lean against the wall
to depend on; to rely upon
to attach oneself to; to join with in friendship

entries.zh: 附会（攀附结交；牵强附会）
entries.en: to attach oneself to; to associate with; to stretch an interpretation
to depend on; to rely on; to comply with

entries.zh: 靠拢他人、与人相并（字样“俠”疑为“挾”）
entries.en: to draw close to another; to side with someone
entries.notes: 字栏“俠”(hiā) 与西义 arrimarse con otro 不甚相合，疑为“挾”(hiap) 之形误，取靠拢相并之义。

entries.en: to moor; to anchor (of a ship, to come alongside)
to pile up; to stack one against another

entries.zh: 疊做葩（将房屋叠靠相连、叠合一处）
entries.en: to set houses close against one another; to stack them together
entries.notes: 末字“葩”与音写 paû 对应不明，据西义 arrimar vnas casas otras 与“疊做”结构释义。

entries.zh: 疊做夥（叠合为一伙、并作一处）
entries.en: to join together; to combine into one group
to link in a row; to join successively

entries.zh: 重重（重重相叠、层层相伴）
entries.en: layer upon layer; one upon another, repeatedly
entries.notes: 字栏标注[疑:重重/重疊]，依官话对音 chǒng chǒng 定为“重重”。
